judge.label: LLM rubric score, fresh-context judge, self-assessed — not human QA.
judge.independence_caveat: This judge is a different model family and a fresh context: it saw only the judge prompt, the rubric and the lesson. It did not direct the project and did not author anything in it. It is still a language model scoring a language model's output, so the label applies: not human QA.

notes.bilingual_quality: Arabic text is a literal translation of English, following English word order rather than reading as natural Arabic.

verdict_notes: The lesson scores highly on all criteria except bilingual quality, where the Arabic content is a direct literal rendering, earning a 1. This critical issue causes the gate to fail despite an overall mean of 4.5. The Arabic needs to be rewritten to read naturally.
